title: Tamizhukku En Ondrai Azhuthavum
desc: When a solar flare disrupts the mobile connections in a city, Vasanth, an intelligent person, tries to restore them. But he is unaware that a bomb will be activated if he completes the task.

title: Kanne Kalaimaane
desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, Kamalakannan's grandmother does not want Bharathi to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.

title: A.R.M
desc: Ajayan grapples with his ancestors' complex choices, unearthed through the 'Chiyothivilakku' legacy. Their actions cast long shadows, impacting his present and future.

title: Magadheera
desc: In 400 years, a reincarnated warrior, Harsha, reconnects with his past love while facing a dark force that threatens their budding romance. Can they overcome their fate?

title: Nee Naan Naam
desc: Circumstances force Raja Ram and Nazeera to lead separate lives in different countries. Years later, their daughters strive to reunite the estranged couple.

title: Vishwaroopam
desc: Nirupama, an ambitious woman studying in the USA, marries a dance master, Viswanathan. On being suspicious of his behaviour, she hires a detective, who reveals his true identity and past.

title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

title: Kick
desc: On a train, Shaina and Himanshu discuss their arranged marriage. They share past relationships, unaware they both involve the enigmatic Devi and his dangerous 'kick.'

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who once saved her. Despite her care, his dark past resurfaces, threatening their lives.

title: Most Eligible Bachelor
desc: Harsha's mother arranges 20 potential brides, but he falls for the outspoken Vibha. His unrequited love is tested when she challenges his views on marriage.

title: Porali
desc: Two men relocate to Hyderabad to start a new life and find jobs at a petrol station. Soon, they start a small business and become successful but their past comes to haunt them.

title: Kaali
desc: A surgeon in the USA is haunted by a recurring dream, leading him to uncover his adoption and journey to India to learn about his biological parents.

title: Shadow
desc: Five adventurous friends ignore warnings from locals and family to explore a haunted forest, ready to face whatever spooky surprises await them in the eerie woods.

title: Katamarayudu
desc: Katamarayudu tries to give up his violent ways at the behest of Avantika, his fiancee. However, he is forced to break his promise and take up arms when Avantika's family is threatened by evil forces.

title: Inttelligent
desc: A prosperous software engineer transforms into a vigilante after the loss of his mentor, driven by a quest for vengeance against those accountable for the mentor's demise.

title: 100 Days Of Love
desc: A columnist, with a strained childhood, reconnects with a schoolmate, and falls in love. However, she's engaged, complicating their budding romance.

title: Teesmarkhan
desc: A boy and girl from broken families bond over escaping abuse. Boy becomes Tees Maar Khan, protecting his Amma. They find family with a cop, facing challenges and finding love.

title: Anjani Putra
desc: Heir Viraj battles gangster Bhairava, who aims to seize his family's land illegally, sparking violent enmity and bloodshed.
